root_cause: After #4983 deployed, the first real run reported PERSONAL_SOCIAL_REGISTRY_WRITE:LINKEDIN_PERSONAL_DISPATCH_BLOCKED. Inserting a personal social_posts row makes reconcile_social_post_publication_obligation update that day's obligation, which fires trg_linkedin_personal_obligation_identity_gate_v3. Day 2026-10-01 has no artifact with verified personal truth, so the gate refused it and, because all rows went in one statement, no day was registered.

observed_evidence.gate_check: same predicate as the trigger evaluated per date: all dates 2026-09-22..2026-10-27 pass except 2026-10-01

fix: Write one row per statement, keep the database identity gate untouched, and report refused rows as guard_rejected in the run evidence.
prevention_rule: A registry that crosses a database gate must isolate refusals per row, report them, and never weaken or bypass the gate. A refused day is a finding about the post, not an error to suppress.
terminal_rule: Merged main, deployed Edge function, a real run of the existing six-hour cron job, then social_posts readback of the personal URNs (all days except 2026-10-01) and personal_post_registry.guard_rejected listing 2026-10-01.
